title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Pink lemonade Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Pink Lemonade Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod delivers a fruity twist on a citrus favourite. Sweet berry notes are blended with tangy Lemonade for a sparkling vape that’s juicy, tart, and refreshing all at once. Each pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically replenishes the pod during use. With up to 20,000 puffs depending on your style, this system ensures lasting flavour without coil changes or manual refilling. With a built-in 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod provides smooth vapour and vibrant flavour every time. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, setup is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re good to go.
